Release notes
=============

## v1.2.0 — January 1, 2026
### 🚀 New
* Dark mode for the dashboard, available from your profile menu under Appearance settings.
### 🐛 Fixes
* Tooltips no longer flicker when you move quickly between charts on the analytics page.

## v1.1.0 — November 2, 2025
### 🚀 New
* Team invites let you add colleagues to your workspace straight from the members page.
